answer_1.quote: We generated 1M Korean LGC using 14 state-of-the-art LLMs... The framework generates realistic LGC and subsequently detects and attributes them.

answer_3.quote: We adopt the LLM-as-a-Judge framework, leveraging GPT-4o-2024-08-06 as the primary evaluator given its strong performance in Korean text assessment.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation study comparing LGC with HWC. Four adult evaluators independently rated 210 comments across six dimensions using a 3-point Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were presented with each article‑comment pair and asked to rate: LLM Authorship, Relevance, Specificity, Fairness, Fluency & Naturalness, and Sentiment.
